question.problem: Let $a=[\begin{aligned}0 \\ 4 \\ 3\end{aligned}]$ and $b=[\begin{aligned}11 \\ x \\ 2\end{aligned}].$ Given that the projection of $a$ onto $b$ is the zero vector, find the value of $x.$
question.worked_solution:
Since $a$ is a nonzero vector, its projection onto another nonzero vector $b$ equals the zero vector only when the vectors are perpendicular. 

So, we must have

$$
a⊥b\,⟹\,a\cdot b=0.
$$

Computing the dot product, we obtain

$$
\begin{aligned}a\cdot b & ={a}_{x}\cdot {b}_{x}+{a}_{y}\cdot {b}_{y}+{a}_{z}\cdot {b}_{z} \\  & =0\cdot 11+4\cdot x+3\cdot 2 \\  & =4x+6.\end{aligned}
$$

Setting the dot product equal to $0,$ we get

$$
\begin{aligned}a\cdot b & =0 \\ 4x+6 & =0 \\ 4x & =-6 \\ x & =-\frac{3}{2}.\end{aligned}
$$
